question: How does the text conclude the Śaiva summary and prescribe application when higher enjoyments are desired?
premises: Some Śaiva beings ending here are summarized as belonging to Śrīkaṇṭha.
A practitioner may desire the enjoyments of others.
In that case an application is to be performed.
inference: After summarizing the Śaiva hierarchy, the text gives a rule for applying it when one seeks higher enjoyments.
uncertainties: The precise technical sense of yojana in this ritual context is not specified in the verse.
plain_english: Some Śaiva beings up to this point are summarized as belonging to Śrīkaṇṭha. When someone desires the enjoyments of others, the appropriate application should be made there.
